# TechCloudPro
> Enterprise AI consulting, Oracle NetSuite ERP, CyberArk cybersecurity, and IT staffing solutions. 7 offices across 5 countries. Founded 2005.

## Services
- [AI Consulting & Private LLM Deployment](https://techcloudpro.com/services/ai/): Deploy secure AI within your infrastructure. Private LLM models, agentic AI systems, enterprise RAG. Zero data leakage. SOC 2, HIPAA, GDPR compliant.
- [Oracle NetSuite ERP](https://techcloudpro.com/services/netsuite/): Certified NetSuite Solutions Provider with 1000+ implementations. End-to-end cloud ERP from discovery through go-live and support.
- [CyberArk Cybersecurity](https://techcloudpro.com/services/cybersecurity/): CyberArk-powered privileged access management, AI agent identity security, Zero Trust architecture, SOC 2/HIPAA/GDPR compliance.
- [IT Staffing](https://techcloudpro.com/services/staffing/): Pre-vetted technology talent in 48 hours. AI/ML, Cloud, Cybersecurity, Full-Stack, DevOps, Data Engineering. Transparent $2/hr staffing fee.

## Products
- [BrandMonkz](https://brandmonkz.com): AI-powered CRM and campaign management platform
- [BeatMind](https://beatmind.io): AI music production assistant for DAWs
- [VibingTicket](https://vibingticket.com): Event ticketing and management platform
